name: How to Fudol ~Health Hen~
original_name: How to ふ～どる～ヘルス編～
source:
You’ve always dreamed of having women do whatever you want: no matter how debased or humiliating it is. Too bad you aren’t smart or handsome enough to attract them. Then you suddenly win $100,000 in the National Lottery. Why invest it, when you can get some whores! After all, what are dreams for if you don’t make them come true? Banzai!

[From an [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070211064510/www.elizar.com/?p=11]old review[/url] by Nargrakhan]
translation:
你一直梦想着能让女人们对自己言听计从——无论要求多么下流、多么屈辱。只可惜你既不够聪明，也谈不上英俊，根本讨不到女性欢心。就在这时，你竟天降横财，买彩票一举中了十万美元大奖！放着大把钞票干嘛拿去投资，当然是去风俗店找小姐潇洒一番！毕竟，梦想若不去亲手实现，又有什么意义呢？万岁！

[摘自Nargrakhan撰写的[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070211064510/www.elizar.com/?p=11]早期评测[/url]]
